_help.how_to_edit: Edit the real settings above. This _help object is ignored by the application and keeps the file valid JSON (JSON does not support // comments). Restart the faucet after changing settings. Existing config.json files are never overwritten by the launcher.
_help.listen: Address and port used by THIS faucet website. Default 127.0.0.1:8787 is local-only. 8080 (IPFS) and 8000 (Skywire) are rejected. This is separate from the NESS node API on 6660.
_help.data_dir: Directory holding signing.seed, state.jsonl and server.lock. Relative paths use the process working directory; START-WINDOWS.cmd uses the extracted app folder. Use an absolute path to retain an existing installation. Back up this directory and config while stopped. Never delete it to clear a timer: it contains signing keys and payment history.
_help.secure_cookies: false for local HTTP. Set true when visitors use HTTPS through your reverse proxy; browsers then send the session cookie only over HTTPS. Setting true while using plain HTTP breaks sessions.
_help.public_origin: Empty for local access. On the confirmed public hostname use https://market.ness.cx, with secure_cookies true and an HTTPS reverse proxy.
_help.timezone: IANA timezone used by the legacy signed-token protocol. Keep UTC for new installations. Do not change it after issuing tokens: older signatures depend on the original timezone. Windows timezone data is bundled.
_help.ness_url: Base URL of your NESS node HTTP API: http://127.0.0.1:6660. Do not append /api/v1. The node must run NESS chain parameters and enable READ,WALLET,TXN API sets. Leave blank to disable NESS integration. Remote HTTP sends credentials unencrypted; prefer a private local connection or HTTPS.
_help.ness_wallet: Wallet ID/filename known to the NESS node, for example 2025_01_01_example.wlt. This is NOT a wallet address, private key, seed, or a path on the faucet computer. The wallet funds faucet payouts and generates payment addresses; keep sufficient NESS and NCH in it. Empty disables cash-out.
_help.ness_password: Password used to unlock the configured NESS wallet for address generation and signing. Empty for an unencrypted wallet. Separate from HTTP API authentication; never put a seed or private key here.
_help.ness_api_user: Optional HTTP Basic Auth username configured on the NESS node. Empty when the node does not use Basic Auth. Not a wallet ID.
_help.ness_api_password: Optional HTTP Basic Auth password paired with ness_api_user. Separate from ness_password. Keep config.json private; it contains credentials.
_help.emc_url: Your Emercoin JSON-RPC endpoint, including its actual RPC port and optional path. Use the address from your Emercoin configuration. Empty disables EMC/NVS registration integration. NVS registration requires this RPC service even if customers pay with NESS or NCH.
_help.emc_user: Emercoin JSON-RPC username from its node configuration. Not an EMC address or wallet name.
_help.emc_password: Emercoin JSON-RPC password. Not a seed/private key. Keep this file private. The Emercoin wallet must permit the required name-registration RPC calls.
_help.exchange_url: Legacy recovery only: URL of the external WORM service for requests created by older versions. New exchanges run directly in this Go app and do not use this URL or Emercoin.
_help.coins_per_second: NET NESS awarded per credited token second. Default 0.000001 = one droplet; 10 credited seconds gives 0.000010 NESS. Must be positive, at most 1 NESS, with at most 6 decimal places. Decimal strings are supported and recommended. Credited seconds depend on token age and redemption history; the quote is authoritative.
_help.hours_per_second: NET whole NCH awarded per credited token second. Default 1 means 10 NCH for 10 credited seconds. Positive integer, maximum 1000000. The payout wallet also needs hours for the network fee. Do not deduct another 5% from the quoted recipient reward.
_help.emc_per_100_days: EMC payment price for each started 100-day NVS block. Default 0.01 EMC; 101 days costs 0.02 EMC. Positive decimal, maximum 8 decimal places. This is an operator service price, not a consensus fee.
_help.ness_per_100_days: NESS alternative payment price for each started 100-day NVS block. Default 0.1 NESS; 101 days costs 0.2 NESS. Positive decimal, maximum 6 decimal places. Customer chooses one offered currency; they do not pay all three.
_help.nch_per_100_days: NCH alternative payment price for each started 100-day NVS block. Default 1 NCH; 101 days costs 2 NCH. Positive whole number. An NCH payment also carries exactly 0.000001 NESS to its generated payment address.
_help.node_policy: The NESS NODE process must report burn_factor=20 and max_decimals=6 in both user_verify_transaction and unconfirmed_verify_transaction. For the mixed 10/3 versus 20/6 issue, set USER_BURN_FACTOR=20 and USER_MAX_DECIMALS=6 BEFORE starting the NODE. Setting them only on the faucet has no effect.
_help.claim_wait: The server records eight seconds before releasing the signed claim. Wallet generation and backup happen alongside it. Blockchain confirmations have their own timing.
_help.emc_wallet: Exact loaded Emercoin wallet name. Empty string selects the unnamed default wallet; null auto-selects only when exactly one wallet is loaded. Set this from your actual node configuration.
_help.direct_exchange: Fixed rate: 10000 whole NCH = 1 NESS, using exact integer arithmetic. A customer deposits exactly the quoted NCH plus 0.000001 NESS to a unique wallet address, then checks payment after confirmation. The wallet funds the quoted NET NESS and payout network fee. Pending quotes reserve liquidity and deposit addresses; do not spend from this wallet outside the app. Cancel unused requests before sending funds to release reserved liquidity. Late deposits to cancelled addresses require operator reconciliation. Review states must never be blindly retried.
